title: Swoon'd Curriculum Root (split layout, contract 1.1)
description: docs/courses/<id>/curriculum/course.json. Course-level data for the split layout; unit bodies live in units/<NN>-<unit-id>.json (curriculum-unit.schema.json). The validator merges root + units (in unitOrder) into a full curriculum.schema.json object before running cross-checks and lint. Additive to v1.0: single-file curricula stay valid.

contractVersion.description: 1.1.0 or later 1.x; the split layout does not exist in 1.0. Use 1.2.0 when the file uses branch, branches[], lesson live or activity branchId.

locale.description: Optional; defaults to en-US when merged.

concepts.description: Course-wide concepts. May be empty: units may contribute their own concepts[]. The merged list must be non-empty and free of duplicate ids.

unitOrder.description: Unit ids in course order. Must match exactly the set of unit files under units/.
